title: Salmon Valley Campground

services.name: Our Campground
services.desc: Salmon Valley Campground, is located along the beautiful Salmon River. We are 25 minutes North of Prince George, British Columbia just off of Highway 97, a popular route to Alaska. We are now open for the season and our season will come to a close on September 14th. Imagine waking up in the morning, surrounded by beautiful old growth trees, the sound of birds and the sights and sounds of the river. There is something very peaceful about our little paradise that allows you to relax and unwind. If you are looking for a fun and relaxing camping destination for your next family vacation, we are the perfect spot. Our management and staff will help you plan out some wonderful outdoor adventures
